attributes.action: Protect Lawful Migrants - Changing Settlement Rules & Excessive Immigration Fees
attributes.additional_details: People who have lived lawfully in the UK for years should not face unexpected settlement requirements halfway through an established immigration route. Many have built their lives and families in reliance on the rules that applied when they arrived. The Government should protect existing residents with clear transitional arrangements, recognise qualifying residence already accrued, and explain how reforms will affect them. Policy can change, but people deserve fair notice and legal certainty.
attributes.background: We ask the Government to protect existing lawful residents from unfair changes to settlement rules, introduce proportionate and transparent immigration fees, and publish clear transitional arrangements for people already working towards settlement.

rejection.details:
